FA9302-26-R-R006 Page - 7 - of 39 1.6.7 Factory-acceptance testing, including both Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) and Hardware-in- the-Loop (HITL) testing, shall be conducted by the contractor prior to live flight testing at Edwards AFB. This will be an addition to the current ATD-GCMS in the Fires team of the Chemistry department to be able to deal with the volume of fire cases submitted to FSI. Materials submitted for analysis ignitable liquids include debris samples taken from a fire scene, clothing taken from suspects or victims, or any other solid sample where it is desired to determine whether or not there are ignitable liquids associated with it. Such samples are submitted to the Laboratory in sealed nylon bags. entity_geography.text: dio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. Therefore, Crestron remains the only provider capable of meeting the technical and compatibility needs for this upgrade. 2. What is the impact to the government if another vendor/brand is used? Include any dollar, schedule, or compatibility impacts if possible. Utilizing a different vendor or brand could result in significant schedule delays, as the government would need to evaluate, integrate, and train personnel on unfamiliar equipment. Previous experience indicates that such processes can considerably slow project progress. Additionally, switching to an alternative brand may introduce compatibility issues with the existing Crestron-based infrastructure, necessitating further technical adjustments, extended testing, and new approval procedures before the system can operate correctly. These challenges are likely to increase costs, compromise reliability, and disrupt operational continuity, making alternative brands both time-consuming and financially burdensome for the government. Uzasadnienie – korzyści dla Zamawiającego: ● jeden dostawca i jeden kanał serwisowy dla obu urządzeń – jedno zgłoszenie, jeden SLA, brak sporów kompetencyjnych między producentami, co bezpośrednio wspiera dotrzymanie 72-godzinnego terminu naprawy z § 5 ust. 3 projektu umowy; ● pełna zamienność urządzeń – w razie awarii jednej drukarki druga przejmuje jej zadania bez rekonfiguracji systemu LIS, co zapewnia rzeczywistą redundancję pracowni (przy dwóch różnych modelach redundancja jest pozorna); ● jeden zestaw części zamiennych, filtrów i procedur konserwacyjnych – niższe koszty utrzyma nia po okresie gwarancji i mniejszy magazyn części; ● jedno szkolenie dla personelu i jedna instrukcja obsługi – skrócenie szkolenia Grupy 1 i Grupy 2, mniejsze ryzyko błędu operato
